svg.text: Transparent RDP Proxy: MSTSC Client (:23389) → Proxy → Target Server (:3389)
2. Protocol Stack & Two Independent RDP Sessions
Application: Input PDU ↔ Graphics/Update PDU ↔ Virtual Channels
Application: Input PDU ↔ Graphics/Update PDU ↔ Virtual Channels
Security: NLA / CredSSP / TLS (credential injection here)
Two SEPARATE TLS sessions — proxy terminates and re-initiates
... MCS Erect Domain, Attach User, Channel Join (all relayed) ...
... Synchronize, Control Cooperate, Font List (both directions) ...
Virtual Channels (clipboard, audio, drive, etc.) — pf_channel.c
Proxy presents its own TLS cert to client (CertificateFile in config). Client sees proxy cert, not target cert.
Proxy independently validates target cert on the backend connection. Two separate TLS tunnels.
TargetUser/TargetPassword in config → injected into pf_client NLA/CredSSP towards target.
Client credentials captured in pf_server_logon() via SEC_WINNT_AUTH_IDENTITY.
connection.c — Full MS-RDPBCGR connection sequence state machine
nla.c — Network Level Authentication (NTLM/Kerberos/SPNEGO via SSPI)
mcs.c — T.125 MCS layer (Connect, Domain, User, Channel operations)
tpdu.c / tpkt.c — X.224 + RFC 1006 transport framing
rdp.c — Core RDP state machine and PDU dispatch
